== flags
--color	colorize output
--config	config file
--dir	work directory
--exec	program to run
--format	output format
--group	group to run as
--host	host to reach
--level	how much to say
--no-color	
--set	override a setting
--speed	how fast to go
--token	API token
--user	account to run as

== quote-all
'a b'	
r#'it's $HOME'#	
'say "hi"'	
'`touch pwned`'	
'$(touch pwned)'	
'x;touch pwned'	
'star*'	
'~root'	
'o’neil;touch pwned'	
'“q”'	
'back\slash'	
'a\:b'	
'C:\Users\me'	a path: C:\Users\me
'a!b'	
r#'ends''#	
'{a,b}'	
'a&b|c<d>e'	
'#hash'	
true	
'null'	
-foo.bar	
'--%'	
'–a.b'	
-a:	
== quote-shared
'x;touch pwned'	
'x;touch pwnedz'	
'x y'	
'x,y'	
== quote-typed-quote
r#'it's $HOME'#	
== quote-typed-quote-shared
'x;touch pwned'	
'x;touch pwnedz'	
'x y'	
'x,y'	
== quote-typed-backslash
== quote-colon
host:8080	
host:9090	
== quote-inline
'--odd=x;touch pwned'
